narrative: 起源故事、笑点、一座应该看起来像被印刷出来的城市：人物依然占据着真实空间，但印刷的法则覆盖在照片之上。用单一的布光方向，让墨线有一个太阳。
不要出现对话气泡。生成模型会把字母画得一团糟。
如果墨线柔和、脸依然保持人性，对话戏是可以承受这个风格的。当你需要纪录片式的毛孔质感、不要线条，或你实际上想要的是完整的动画（Animation）时，它就是错误的工具。
如果没有摄影机的颗粒感或光晕溢出，你就已经离开了真人拍摄，画出了一幅插图。
how: 锁定35mm或50mm焦段，平视高度。一盏硬光或硬柔混合的主光，让边缘有明确的受光面。
要求勾勒出墨线轮廓、阴影处的网点效果，以及一张依然是照片的脸。有限的色块。
不要气泡。Prompt: Comic-book treatment of [Subject], inked edges, halftone, panel energy, a page that moves.
对于视频而言，印刷效果保持不变，同时身体做出一个小动作。
when: 一个笑点、一个起源节拍、一座应该看起来像被印刷出来的城市。不要把它当作卡通滤镜用在低语式的剧情戏上，也不要加入气泡。
vs: 动画（Animation）是从头到尾都手绘出来的。漫画风则是穿上了印刷外衣的真人拍摄。
动态文字（Typography）把字母本身当作主体。闪光漫画（Flash Comic）则是在同样的墨线之上，加上了一次闪光爆炸。
双色调（Two Color）是一种更严格的用墨限制。
examples_film: 《至尊神探》（Dick Tracy）用局部色彩和硬朗的妆容，把印刷法则施加在被拍摄的脸上。《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》（Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse）是动画作品，你可以借鉴它的色调语言，但不要照搬某一帧画面。
静帧应该看起来是可以被印刷出来的。
mistakes: 过度处理成没有镜头感的卡通，或与泼墨特效和油画质感叠加在一起。破绽是没有摄影机颗粒感，也没有光的方向。
修正方法：单一的光照方向、阴影处的网点效果，以及一张依然是照片的脸。

faq.q: 电影中的漫画风（Comic）是什么？
faq.a: 一种穿上印刷法则外衣的真人拍摄：墨线勾勒的边缘、网点效果、有限的色彩，以及一个被拍摄下来的身体。摄影机依然有一个真实的镜头。这不是一张漫画页面的扫描件。
动画是把整幅画面都手绘出来的。漫画风则保留了摄影结构，并加上墨线和网点。如果没有镜头感，你就已经脱离了这个风格。
起源节拍、笑点、一座被印刷出来的城市。当你需要朴素的纪录片式皮肤质感时跳过它，也要跳过对话气泡。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写漫画风的提示词？
faq.a: 先说明主体、镜头和一盏主光，然后禁止出现对话气泡，保持脸部的摄影质感。

narrative: Origin stories, punchlines, a city that should look published: the person still occupies space, but print law sits on top of the photograph. One lighting direction so the ink has a sun.
No speech balloons. Models ruin letters.
Dialogue can survive if the ink is gentle and the faces stay human. It is the wrong tool when you need documentary pores and no line, or when you actually wanted full Animation.
If there is no grain or halation of a camera, you left live action and drew a still.
how: Lock a 35mm or 50mm at eye height. One hard or hard-soft key so edges have a side.
Ask for inked contours, halftone in shadows, a face that is still a photograph. Limited color spots.
No balloons. Prompt: Comic-book treatment of [Subject], inked edges, halftone, panel energy, a page that moves.
For video, the print holds while the body makes one small action.
when: A punchline, an origin beat, a city that should look printed. Do not use it as a cartoon filter on a whispering drama, and do not add balloons.
vs: Animation is drawn throughout. Comic is live action wearing print.
Typography makes letters the subject. Flash Comic adds a strobe bang on top of the same ink.
Two Color is a stricter ink budget.
examples_film: Dick Tracy uses spot color and hard makeup as print law on photographed faces. Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse is animation you may borrow as a grade language, not as a frame to copy.
mistakes: Over-processing into a cartoon with no lens, or stacking this with Ink Riot and oil. The tell is no camera grain and no sun.
Fix it: one light direction, halftone in shadows, face still a photograph.

faq.a: Live-action coverage wearing print law: inked edges, halftone, limited color, a photographed body. The camera still has a lens. It is not a scan of a comic page.
Animation is drawn as the whole image. Comic keeps photographic structure and adds ink and halftone. If there is no lens, you left this look.
Origin beats, punchlines, a published city. Skip it when you need plain documentary skin, and skip balloons.

faq.q: How do I prompt Comic for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name subject, lens, and one key, then: Comic-book treatment of [Subject], inked edges, halftone, panel energy, a page that moves. Forbid speech balloons. Keep the face photographic.
